fusions.name: Quarry Mark
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Chase
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 8 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 8% per affliction on the target (max 40%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wounded Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
